Name: Talk to All Here NOW
Author: NeJoRo
Description:
[size=4]Tired of talking to every NPC out of 80+? With [b]SAME, UNCHANGED[/b] dialoges? [i][b]EXPECIALLY on Festivals[/b][/i]? This solution is for [u]you[/u]![/size]

Basically, this mod adds a button to CJB Cheats Menu (Relationships tab) to mark all NPCs on the current map as talked to today. Works on ordinary and festival days.


I do not take any credits for code, as I used AI to make it. I'm not proud of it. Do whatever you want with it.

I'll try to fix things if there's any bugs.

Downloads.Description: Fixed issue with button being over cursor. Logic of mod was rewritten a bit. Updated clear list (F8 by deafult to clear unnecessary NPCs). Config file opens through GMCM! .1 Put mod into folder. Oopsie

Manifest.Name: CJB Talk To All Here
Manifest.Description: Adds a first button on CJB Cheats Menu Relationships tab to talk-to-all NPCs present here. Includes optional cleanup for junk friendships.
